title: Stadium crowds: reverse-looping ATM screens play back and forth
summary: The animated stadium screens that the original plays backward at the end of a loop now do the same. Before, the port held them on their first frame.
details: The original clock reflects off the last frame and plays backward when the reverse-loop flag is set, then turns forward again below zero. The port ignored this for every stadium crowd sheet.
Every reverse sheet in the shipped archives is a stadium crowd, on Supercross, the Freestyle stadiums and GAME01. They are now animated.
Evidence and limits are in research/STADIUM_MATERIALS.md.
limitation: The PR records no check on a phone or against the original hardware. The crowd screens are checked as two still captures four steps apart, not by watching the motion.
verification: atv-core unit test of the ping-pong sequence, overshoot reflection, the below-zero mirror and the non-looping sticky stop. Native captures of SX01 and SX09 four steps apart: the stand pixels change, the ground pixels stay identical.
